instruction.text: Jasmine has <mat><t-yellow>2</t-yellow>/<t-purple>3</t-purple></mat> of a pizza left over. She intends to give each of her <t-blue>4</t-blue> friends an equal part of the remaining pizza. How much does everyone get?

atoms.a: Write the answer to the division as a fraction with the denominator found above.
Write the fraction in its simplest form.

instruction.text: For an art project, Jenny needs to cut <mat><t-yellow>5</t-yellow>/<t-purple>8</t-purple></mat> of a metre of wire into <t-blue>7</t-blue> equal pieces. How long will each piece be?

atoms.a: Write the answer to the division as a fraction.

instruction.text: Simon saved <mat><t-yellow>1</t-yellow>/<t-purple>2</t-purple></mat> of a pound from his pocket money. He wants to divide this saving equally among <t-blue>5</t-blue> of his friends. How much money will each friend receive?

atoms.b: Each friend will receive <mat><gap>1</gap>/<t-purple>10</t-purple></mat> of a pound.

instruction.text: Maria has a jug which contains <mat><t-yellow>3</t-yellow>/<t-purple>5</t-purple></mat> of a litre of water. She needs to distribute this water evenly into <t-blue>5</t-blue> smaller bottles. How many litres of water will each bottle contain?

atoms.b: Each bottle will contain <mat><gap>3</gap>/<t-purple>25</t-purple></mat> of a litre of water.

instruction.text: Leah wants to bake half the amount of cookies from a recipe which needs <mat><t-yellow>1</t-yellow>/<t-purple>5</t-purple></mat> of a kilogram of flour. How much flour will she need?

atoms.b: She needs <mat><gap>1</gap>/<t-purple>10</t-purple></mat> of a kilogram of flour to make half of the recipe.
